hero.heading: Community Forum
hero.subtitle: A secure, moderated, and confidential discussion forum for adult gurukuli survivors. Connect with peers, share resources, and discuss therapeutic journeys in a safe space designed to honour your privacy and agency.

safetyNotice.heading: Safety Notice
safetyNotice.body: This forum is restricted to verified adult survivors of gurukula abuse. All discussions are protected under secure clinical protocols.

crisisTeaser.heading: Need Immediate Support?
crisisTeaser.body: If you are experiencing acute distress, please reach out to our dedicated support channels or external help.
